bosses.name: Abyssal Slime
bosses.blurb: World boss — compete for the highest score, measured by total damage dealt before you die or the timer runs out.

mechanics.name: Wake-up Kickback
mechanics.text: When he exits knockdown he unleashes a huge, high-damage kickback. Stun him exactly as the knockdown is ending to cancel it entirely — Carmen's Extreme nails the timing.

tips: He is weak to Mental, so Mental dealers post the highest scores.
Bring one reliable stun to neutralize the Wake-up Kickback and protect your run.
Score is cumulative damage-before-death — survivability and uptime matter as much as raw burst.

recommended.note: Mental DoT + execute — strong sustained score.
Mental burst — her Extreme also stuns, but it does big bonus damage to knocked-down targets, so land it DURING a knockdown rather than spending it to cancel the wake-up.
Carmen — Extreme stun times the Wake-up Kickback; peels/heals.

control.note: Carmen — Extreme stun; time it to the knockdown ending to cancel the kickback.
Dusan — very readable timing between the hits and the CC, making the interrupt easy to land.
Xini — Extreme applies a knockdown (surfaced from her skill text); useful control, confirm timing in-run.
